facts.text: MujocoUR5eCableEnv is registered as robo_manip_baselines/MujocoUR5eCableEnv-v0 with entry point robo_manip_baselines.envs.mujoco:MujocoUR5eCableEnv
The class subclasses MujocoUR5eEnvBase and passes the scene env_ur5e_cable.xml and the init qpos [pi, -pi/2, -0.75*pi, -0.25*pi, pi/2, pi/2] followed by eight zeros
MujocoEnvBase subclasses gymnasium.envs.mujoco:MujocoEnv and calls it with the model path, frame_skip 8, the observation space, 640x480 rendering and the default camera config
The scene sets the MuJoCo timestep to 0.004 s
MujocoEnvBase sets sim_timestep to 0.004 s and frame_skip to 8, so one environment step advances 0.032 s
The observation space is a Dict of three Box spaces: joint_pos (7), joint_vel (7) and wrench (6), each unbounded (-inf, inf)

The observation concatenates six arm joint positions and velocities with one normalized gripper value (rad2deg of the mean gripper qpos, divided by 45 and multiplied by 255), a three-axis force and a three-axis torque
step runs do_simulation(action, frame_skip) and returns (observation, reward, terminated=False, truncated=False, info); a TimeLimit wrapper would be the only truncation
reset_model restores init_qpos and init_qvel and returns the observation, so the environment reset has a fixed start pose and does not draw a random one
The cable reward is 1 only when the cable stays below the pole tops, its end is past the second pole and the cable crosses the two poles; otherwise it is 0
The UR5e model defines six arm joint actuators and one gripper tendon actuator
The arm actuator ctrlrange is -6.2831 to 6.2831 and the limited elbow ctrlrange is -3.1415 to 3.1415
The gripper actuator ctrlrange is 0 to 255
The scene includes the UR5e shared and specific configurations and the cable configuration
The upstream pins gymnasium 1.0.0 and mujoco 3.1.6

determinism.notes: the bridge accepts a seed and echoes it, but the upstream reset_model restores init_qpos and init_qvel and does not draw a random start, so the start state is the same for every seed; the fake keeps the same fixed start pose, and its kinematic step is deterministic for the same actions.  modify_world can add np.random noise when world_random_scale is set, but the environment reset does not call it

gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in, not MuJoCo: it moves each of the six arm joint positions toward the action value by a placeholder fraction and moves the normalized gripper value toward the gripper action; it has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, cable or pole collision, actuator forces, sensors, noise or physics integration
the reward is a placeholder 0.0 and the episode never terminates; the upstream reward is 0 or 1 from the cable geometry in MujocoUR5eCableEnv._get_reward

NOT COVERED: the camera RGB and depth images of the three 640x480 cameras (front, left, right) and any tactile intensity maps that the upstream info dictionary carries; the bridge serves no image array and the fake returns an empty info
the fake returns Python lists of floats; upstream returns numpy float64 arrays, and no rendering is implemented
upstream needs gymnasium 1.0.0 and mujoco 3.1.6; neither is installed where the gate runs and the sim backend was not run, so no fake trajectory was compared with the real environment
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
